reviews.comment: I had him for 322 not 323 but he was the most caring professor I've ever had. Super sweet, chill guy and want his students to succeed in the course. Lectures were unengaging at times but he was always there to answer and questions and clarify any points. The practice exams were great study material for the exams.

The most sweet and caring professor. Weekly homework that is mostly based on completion. He records and posts lectures after every class. Attendance not mandatory. Tests are really similar to homework problems, and he grades with a lot of partial credit. Super accessible out of class! Had a family emergency and he let me take the exam a week later.

Ugaz is the kindest soul. He truly cares for his students. This was his first time teaching CHEN 323, so he was learning it along with us. Weekly homeworks were easy and mostly completion. Lectures were good and he provided a lot of other resources to help learn material. Exams were similar to homework problems and very simple math problems.

He made this class straight forward and is a super nice guy, he also gives lots of partial credit and exam are similar to the homework's. The only thing I didn't like is he spends SO much time in class deriving equations which can be super hard to get through. Other than that he is amazing.

CHEN 399 during Fall Semester. This class is very chill. First Assignment is filling out a google form to determine if you have a high impact experience. Second Assignment is writing a short essay on this experience. Prof Ugaz grades nicely and is very supportive. If done, you are given an S. Cares about his students, will help you!

CHEN 304 during Fall Semester. Prof Ugaz lectures well and provides recordings and annotations on Canvas. Is passionate about topics. Grades nicely on Exams as he tries to find where you made your mistake to give as much partial as possible. Provides detailed reviews before all exams and gives pointers. Cares about his students, will help you!

Homework had numerical answers included, so you could check if you got the right answer. They were also mostly completion. Tests were very easy if you did the homework. He gave worked out answers to tests and homework after each was due.
I really liked his class! All the assignments were about improving yourself, so homework wasn't hard. The biggest assignment was a book reading and that was totally easy!

VERY generous with partial credit. Uploads all lectures and notes online, and often posts videos explaining the process to understand the problems and goes over them slowly. The subject is hard, but definitely doable and Ugaz makes it a lot more enjoyable. Occasionally throws in funny tidbits or real life applications to lecture.

Ugaz has been the best professor I've taken so far. While fluid operations is not an easy subject, Ugaz has given me a deep understanding of the material. He always helps out when you are confused on a topic and his video guides are very helpful. My only complaint is he doesn't teach more classes. I would definitely recommend him.
Taught well and really cares about his students learning beyond his class. He's a quirky dude, but that's part of the greatness you'll encounter when you get to learn from Father ChemE himself.

Dr. Ugaz is very helpful inside & outside of class. The homework is tough, but he is more than willing to help you with it. He posts very helpful YouTube videos to give you guidance. The key to his class is to rework the homework problems before the exam as many times as possible. He grades more on knowing the process vs. getting the right answer.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Ugaz is truly one of the nicest professors I've ever met! Regularly went over tricky homework problems in class, and provided supplemental YouTube videos with additional homework and conceptual help. He also has his lectures on YouTube. Very lenient grader, both on the homework problems and exam problems. Highly Recommend!

Ugaz truly cares that students learn the material. Lecture can be a bit repetitive if you understand the topics covered in Youtube videos well. He'll also discuss how to setup HW problems, so going to class is still worth it. Book used primarily for its charts/tables. Work efficiently and exams are fine, he'll curve if necessary.

Dr. Ugaz is a really caring professor and will bless you with a lot of partial credit. However, lectures, to me, are hard to pay attention to and can be substituted by watching lecture recordings (which I play at 2x speed) and his YouTube videos. Exams are somewhat similar to homework problems, but doesn't give you time to complete them.

Dr. Ugaz is a sweetheart. His class covers difficult concepts, but he explains it very well through his youtube videos and in class lectures. He posts his lectures online, so it's difficult to will yourself to attend his class, but you will learn during and for his tests. He's a very lenient grader, which makes a typically hard class low stress.
